eligibility: Active questions with Kind equal to the requested kind or both; optional subject and stable TopicId filters.
selection: Randomized round robin across subjects; interleaved topic queues within subjects. There is no fixed stored exam sequence or static exam template.
persistence: Selections and answer keys are snapshotted into owner-linked cent_attempts / cent_attempt_questions. Those tables were not read or exported.
limitations: Runtime behavior is documented from source inspection only. No attempt or exam was generated during this audit.
